knowledge:
- key_parameters: plot=TRUE/FALSE ;; controls whether to output plots for heatmaps, averages, Fisher's tests, and odd ratios ;; file_seq ;; path to input multiple sequence alignment FASTA file for hmmbuild ;; file_out ;; output filename for the built HMM ;; pathHMMER ;; system path to the HMMER binaries directory, e.g., "/usr/bin/"
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use when you have targeted bisulfite sequencing or NGS reads from two conditions (e.g., healthy vs. tumor) and a reference sequence, and you want to perform single-CpG comparative methylation analysis, pattern entropy analysis, or profile HMM sequence similarity scoring.
- pitfalls: Calculating methylation average assumes perfect alignment with no mismatches or indels, which is an idealized assumption ;; Profile HMM functions (hmmbuild and nhmmer) require external HMMER software installed on the host system at the specified pathHMMER path, otherwise they will fail.

workflows.name: comparative_methylation_analysis
workflows.intent: Align NGS reads from two conditions to a reference sequence and perform comparative methylation analysis.
input: Healthy.fasta (FASTA file of reads from condition 1)
Tumor.fasta (FASTA file of reads from condition 2)
Reference.fasta (FASTA file of the reference sequence)
workflows.stages: 1. Load FASTA files ;; 2. Align reads to reference using methAlign ;; 3. Generate methylation heatmap using methHeatmap ;; 4. Calculate methylation average using methAvg ;; 5. Calculate methylation entropy using methEntropy ;; 6. Identify significant CpG sites using fishertest_cpg ;; 7. Calculate log odd ratios using odd_ratio ;; 8. Run complete comparative pipeline using compare_samples
workflows.code:
library(MethTargetedNGS)
healthy = system.file("extdata", "Healthy.fasta", package = "MethTargetedNGS")
tumor = system.file("extdata", "Tumor.fasta", package = "MethTargetedNGS")
reference = system.file("extdata", "Reference.fasta", package = "MethTargetedNGS")
hAlign = methAlign(healthy,reference)
tAlign = methAlign(tumor,reference)
hHeatmap = methHeatmap(hAlign,plot=TRUE)
hAvg = methAvg(hAlign,plot=FALSE)
hEnt <- methEntropy(hAlign)
SigCpGsites = fishertest_cpg(hAlign,tAlign,plot=FALSE)
odSamps = odd_ratio(hAlign,tAlign,plot=FALSE)
compare_samples(hAlign,tAlign)

workflows.name: profile_hmm_analysis
workflows.intent: Build a Profile HMM from a multiple sequence alignment and calculate sequence likelihoods.
input: msa.fasta (FASTA file of multiple sequence alignment)
workflows.stages: 1. Load MSA and query FASTA files ;; 2. Build Profile HMM using hmmbuild ;; 3. Calculate sequence likelihoods against the HMM using nhmmer
